units.source_text: “今天能下完的话，就把它下完吧。”

en.t: If we can finish the game today, let us finish it.

units.source_text: 十二月四日早晨，名人对工作人员说道。

en.t: On the morning of December 4, the Master said this to the staff.

units.source_text: 上午对局时，他也对大竹七段说：

en.t: During the morning session, he also said to Otake seventh dan:
